problemSigns.detail: This is often the sound of a spring snapping due to fatigue or overload.

problemSigns.sign: Door won't lift or feels extremely heavy
problemSigns.detail: Without spring tension, the garage door's weight is unsupported, making it very difficult to open.

problemSigns.sign: Visible gap in the torsion spring above the door
problemSigns.detail: A clear separation in the coiled spring indicates a break.

problemSigns.sign: Door lifts a few inches then stops
problemSigns.detail: This can happen when one spring breaks on a two-spring system, leaving insufficient lift power.
Broken springs release tension, causing the lift cables to go slack or unravel.
